content.markdown:
**V1.4.7** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on February 18th, 2022.

## V1.4.7

- Feature - Parsing Optimization
  - With an update to our parsing system, you can expect save and vehicle files to be significantly smaller in size; we managed to reduce the default mission vehicles by ~50%. We are not only hoping this will save users storage space but also reduce load times when sending vehicle data in multiplayer. You may need to re-save your vehicles.
- Fix - [#5064](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5064) Fix health sync requests causing ragdoll on respawn
- Rework - [#5381](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5381) Added addon option to disable natural disasters in default missions
- Fix - [#5158](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5158) Adjusted default natural disaster period from 5min to 15min
- Fix - Volcanic ash now affects jet engine intakes
- Fix - [#2943](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2943) Increased relevance threshold for radar hits by 10x
- Fix - [#4395](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4395) increase detection range for cargo deliveries / cargo not delivering to large zones
- Fix - [#2973](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2973) Added buoyancy surfaces to motors and generators / modular engines sometimes not linking correctly
- Fix - [#4862](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4862) Unable to un-crouch when carrying a survivor
- Fix - Initialize AI Aircraft state on vehicle load (Aircraft dropping out of the sky on load)
- Rework - [#1986](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/1986) Solid rockets lose fuel on damage and take damage anywhere along the body of the rocket
- Fix - [#3763](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3763) Emp warhead now uses built-in impact threshold
- Fix - [#3781](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3781) Rename detonate warhead nodes to Arm
- Fix - [#2792](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2792) SetVehiclePosSafe not accounting for target vehicle bounds size
- Fix - [#4061](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4061) Muzzle break -> muzzle brake spelling error
- Fix - [#2165](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2165) Keypads not de-focusing when leaving their range
- Fix - [#4727](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4727) Arctic volcano mesh fixes
- Fix - [#4686](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4686) Train-line mesh issue for Donkk arctic exit and track diagonal variant
- Fix - [#4996](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4996) All electric parts should now be disabled by EMP blasts
- Fix - [#4941](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4941) Fluid cannon mass increased from 1 to 11
- Fix - Impeller pump preventing flow when torque slot not connected
- Fix - Ocean surface render issues
- Fix - Reduce particle spawn rate for lava physics contacts
- Fix - Lava emissive texture ignoring fog
- Fix - [#3472](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3472) Projectile splash damage not affecting MP clients (Fixed for non-dedicated servers)
- Fix - [#4507](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4507) Emotes broken when crouched
- Fix - Minor tornado position desync for mp clients
- Fix - [#5091](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5091) Tornados bypass damage prevention
- Fix - [#4930](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4930) Siren component placement surfaces removed, added to research group
- Fix - [#5173](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5173) Add success returns for disaster lua functions and rework volcano spawning checks
- Fix - [#5172](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5172) Remove success return from guaranteed functions getWeather, getTime and cancelGerstner
- Fix - [#5048](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5048) Add tsunami callback for meteors and add lua param to allow meteor tsunamis
- Fix - [#4435](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4435) remove duplicate onVehicleDespawn() lua callback call
- Fix - [#4510](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4510) getAiTarget returning vehicle/char ids as numbers not integers
- Fix - Creative menu button not calling onVolcano
- Fix - [#4580](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4580) Return params for getAiTarget
- Fix - [#5396](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/5396) Megalodons spawned with volcanic eruption button
- Balance - [#4925](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4925) set fish flee speed higher than player swim speed
- Balance - Increased fish scare distance
- Balance - Increased fish max spawn depth

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3136197890749372670)
